in_sanskrit.name: शरय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: May that night grow (be auspicious) and that goddess of the night be propitious.

in_marathi.name: Sharay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word 'Shri' which means 'King', 'Ruler', or 'Goddess of Wealth and Fortune'. The name Sharay signifies the power and authority of a ruler, as well as the divine blessings and prosperity that come with it.

The name Sharay signifies the power and authority of a ruler, as well as the divine blessings and prosperity that come with it.
